verdict.rationale: smolagents explicitly supports swapping the underlying model/provider via local transformers, ollama, Hub providers, or OpenAI/Anthropic/etc. through LiteLLM integration, with the model passed as a simple constructor argument independent of agent logic. This is documented directly in the GitHub README and reflected in usage examples showing model injection. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on benchmark confirming zero-friction swapping across many providers in practice.
